tagline: Reviews secret-blast-radius invocations and records which offline report forms were checked as read-only.
summary: secret-blast-radius lists which credentials a malicious npm install could reach on a machine or CI runner and prints an ordered rotation plan. It never prints secret values and does not modify files unless you request a report file with --sarif-file or --runbook-file. This extension keeps every invocation under review: its root rule records the offline report forms (--help, --version, --json, --sarif, --runbook, --harden, --list-incidents, --no-exec) as reviewed read-only literals, while the opt-in --osv lookup (sends lockfile package names and versions to api.osv.dev) and --sarif-file/--runbook-file writes stay reviewed by that rule too. The conservative unclassified rule also reviews every invocation.
limitations: Every invocation, including the reviewed read-only forms, keeps review through the conservative unclassified rule.
The extension classifies invocations; it does not verify the installed package or its findings.
A maintainer profile is not a security certification or an official upstream endorsement.
